body.text: Claude’s free plan uses every paste to improve its AI, including private customer details.
The ‘Data Sharing’ setting is on by default, so your inputs could appear in future responses.

Disable it in settings to keep your data private—paid plans don’t do this unless you opt in.

Toggle it off to stop Claude from storing or learning from your inputs.
Paid plans don’t train on your data unless you opt in—free plans do the opposite.
Check this setting every few weeks—updates sometimes reset it.

carousels.hook: Meta Ads bury creatives that take 3 seconds to show the problem
carousels.throughline: Meta Ads reward creatives that solve a problem in the first 2 seconds—this template speeds up every ad and boosts conversions.

reel_beats.hook: Meta buries ads that take 3 seconds to show the problem

body.text: Meta’s algorithm favors ads that solve a problem in the first 2 seconds of the video.
Ads that start with the product instead of the problem lose viewers before the hook lands.
Use this script: ‘Tired of [problem]? Here’s how [solution] works in seconds.’
Text overlay in the first 2 seconds ensures the message lands even without sound.

screen.title: Meta Ads 2-second script
screen.mechanism: Starting with the problem boosts retention and conversions in the first 2 seconds.

reel_beats.send_line: Send this to your creative team

body_slides.text: Meta’s algorithm favors ads that grab attention in the first 2 seconds.
Start with the problem, not the product—people scroll past sales pitches.
Use this script: ‘Tired of [problem]? Here’s how [solution] works.’
Add text overlay in the first 2 seconds—most people watch without sound.
Test 3-5 variations of the opening line to see which problem resonates.
Ads that follow this structure see 40% higher click-through rates.
